fields.Name: T373 - Theme Toggle Light and Dark
fields.Description: Exercises the ThemeService.SetTheme round-trip and IsDarkMode re-skin wired through the dynamic user menu — a preference-application path not touched by any grid/form/query test.

InputDefinition.goal: You are logged in at http://localhost:4200. Click the user avatar button in the TOP-RIGHT corner of the header to open the user menu. Find the theme toggle row (it shows a sun/moon switch and a label like 'Theme' or 'Dark Mode') and click it to flip the theme. Verify the entire application visibly re-skins — for example a light interface switches to a dark background with light text (or vice-versa) — and the toggle switch reflects the new state. Then click the toggle again to flip it back. Seeing the whole shell change color scheme is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The user avatar menu opens and shows a theme toggle control (sun/moon switch)
Clicking the toggle visibly changes the app's color scheme (light<->dark) across the header and page background
The toggle switch position/icon updates to reflect the newly applied theme
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
